sources.snippet: Qwen3 TTS reference voices Twenty synthetic reference voices (one female and one male in ten languages) generated with Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-VoiceDesign, dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0, for voice cloning with Qwen3 TTS, VoxCPM2 and Chatterbox. See NOTICE.md and voices.json.
